concerns.text: The plan cites 'Csplk/video-images', 'Csplk/hipcam', and 'yoonlee/csProjectStyle1' as proxies for the S-Agent-300K dataset to extract 3D geometric constraints. These datasets (video frames, hipcam logs, style transfer projects) do not inherently contain the structured 3D object coordinates and spatial relations required for the CSP solver defined in FR-001. Using these as a 'verified proxy' for S-Agent-300K's specific static multi-view geometry is a fundamental dataset mismatch; the solver will fail to find the required variables (x, y, z, object relations) in these sources, rendering the experiment infeasible as planned.

The plan lists 'MichiganNLP/scalable_vlm_probing', '7eu7d7/vlm_data', and 'MMVP/MMVP_VLM' as sources for 'VLM Baseline & Ground Truth'. These are general VLM probing or question-answering datasets, not the specific S-Agent-300K ground truth labels required for the comparative benchmark (US-2). The plan assumes these sources contain the exact ground-truth labels for the S-Agent-300K scenes, which is an unverified and likely false assumption. Without the specific S-Agent-300K ground truth, the accuracy metrics (SC-001) cannot be calculated.
